question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘IMMORAL’ from the given sentence.**

The city of Hamburg and its surrounding region have generally decent health, with no pandemic illnesses having lately developed to any significant degree.
solution:
The correct answer is: Decent

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Immoral: Not conforming to accepted standards of morality. (अनैतिक)
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options section.
 
 
• Degree: The amount, level, or extent to which something happens or is present. (मात्रा)
 
• Decent: Conforming with generally accepted standards of respectable or moral behaviour. (शालीन)
 
• Illness: A disease or period of sickness affecting the body or mind. (बीमारी)
 
• Region: A particular area or part of a state, country, or the earth's surface. (क्षेत्र, प्रदेश)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of 'Immoral' is 'Decent'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
